Coram : A.K. SIKRI*, ASHOK BHUSHAN
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973: s.482 – Quashing of FIRs – In the instant case, lease of land was granted by the Government to the appellant no.1 for construction of world class cricket stadium – Additional land was allotted Panchayat – A club house was constructed on the part of the infrastructure of the allotted land – Another land was allotted for using commercially and a hotel was constructed on it – Appellant no1 was initially registered as a society which was later converted to a company
Decision Date : 02-11-2018 | Case No : CRIMINAL APPEAL No. 1258/2018 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
